title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：teenager　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 teenager 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the headmaster ① taught the teenager that no student in the school would have noted, and he said the teaching was the whole of the year. The ② teenager, meaning the youth itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a teenager, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ teenager in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ teenager at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A teenager, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the headmaster said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the teenager was the whole of the matter, meaning the promise and not the youth. The ⑥ teenager, meaning the promise and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; teenager, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a youth and a promise. He said the promise is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ teenager had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ teenager of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of noting; teenager, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ teenager I remember is the youth noted in the record, which closed in 1960 and is still noted as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ teenager, my mother said in 1962, is the only youth that improves by being noted; every teenager, she said, is a promise that has agreed to look like a youth. She said the promise was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 青少年（指学堂里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 青少年（指那个青少年本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the teenager 教这一个青少年
D. n. 青少年（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 青少年之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的青少年之事）
F. n. 青少年（指学籍册里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 青少年、可塑（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 可塑（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught the teenager that no student in the school would have noted
The teenager, meaning the youth itself and not the bell
the teenager at the far gate
the teenager was the whole of the matter
the teenager had become a line in a record
The teenager of the whole thing
A teenager, my mother said in 1962

answers.why: teach the teenager 意为“教这一个青少年”，1953 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯记下的一个青少年做了一遍。
teenager 意为“青少年”，指那个青少年本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被记下。
teenager 意为“青少年”，指学堂里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
teenager 意为“青少年”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
teenager 意为“青少年、可塑”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个可塑就是那件事的全部。
teenager 意为“可塑”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个青少年，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
teenager 意为“青少年”，指学籍册里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1958 年这一个成了学籍册里的一行。
teenager 意为“青少年之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的青少年之事是一处学堂和三个学年的记下。
teenager 意为“青少年”，我记得的是学籍册里记下过的那一个，1960 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一个。
teenager 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，青少年是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的青少年。
